# Test-only OpenTelemetry OTLP exporters for the Konflux-pinned python CI
# job. test-requirements.txt pulls these unpinned, which resolves newer than
# the AIPCC-pinned opentelemetry-sdk==1.41.1 and breaks OTLPSpanExporter
# imports. They are lazy/optional at runtime and are not shipped in
# Dockerfile.konflux, so they are hashed here rather than in the
# autogenerated Konflux lock files (which requirements/compile.py overwrites).
#
# Install with: uv pip install --require-hashes --no-deps -r this file
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-common==1.41.1 \
    --hash=sha256:10da74dad6a49344b9b7b21b6182e3060373a235fde1528616d5f01f92e66aa9 \
    --hash=sha256:0e253156ea9c36b0bd3d2440c5c9ba7dd1f3fb64ba7a08fc85fbac536b56e1fb
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-grpc==1.41.1 \
    --hash=sha256:537926dcef951136992479af1d9cd88f25e33d56c530e9f020ed57774dca2f94 \
    --hash=sha256:b05df8fa1333dc9a3fda36b676b96b5095ab6016d3f0c3296d430d629ba1443b
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http==1.41.1 \
    --hash=sha256:1a21e8f49c7a946d935551e90947d6c3eb39236723c6624401da0f33d68edcb4 \
